verdict.rationale: GitCafe's docs say its repositories work with any Git client over HTTPS or SSH [gitcafe-docs-1]. Personal access tokens cover Git over HTTPS [gitcafe-docs-22, gitcafe-docs-38], SSH keys imported from GitHub get default SSH access [gitcafe-docs-32], and the CLI sets up Git credentials [gitcafe-docs-10]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of clone/pull/push working, and detailed first-party docs on SSH key management and clone URLs.
